name: week
title: Legal hold review
subtitle: Local records. Recorded evidence is not live preservation.

sections.title: Reviews due
sections.sql: select code,name,status,review_due from holds where status<>'released' order by review_due

sections.title: Acknowledgements to chase
sections.sql: select hold,custodian,response_due,reason from v_chase order by response_due

sections.title: Preservation exceptions
sections.sql: select hold,custodian,system_name,owner,state,attention from v_preservation where attention<>'recorded confirmation'

sections.title: People leaving within thirty days
sections.sql: select name,email,leaving_on,hold,confirmations from v_departures order by leaving_on
